## Architecture Overview

The `consumer.Metrics` interface is defined in `opentelemetry-collector/consumer/metrics.go` with `ConsumeMetrics(ctx context.Context, md pmetric.Metrics) error`. It is implemented by all metric processors and exporters. Adding `ConsumeMetricsWithContext` requires updating all implementations across the ecosystem.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`consumer/metrics.go`** — Defines `Metrics` interface embedding `internal.BaseConsumer` and `ConsumeMetrics()`.
- **`consumer/consumer.go`** — Public consumer.Capabilities type and WithCapabilities() option.
- **`consumer/internal/consumer.go`** — Defines Capabilities struct with MutatesData and BaseConsumer interface.

### Core Implementations

- **`processor/batchprocessor/batch_processor.go`** — Implements consumer.Metrics with Capabilities().
- **`processor/processorhelper/metrics.go`** — `NewMetrics()` creates processors implementing consumer.Metrics.
- **`exporter/exporterhelper/metrics.go`** — `NewMetrics()` creates exporters with metrics handling.
- **`internal/fanoutconsumer/metrics.go`** — Fans out to multiple metrics consumers.

### Contrib Implementations

- **`processor/cumulativetodeltaprocessor/processor.go`** — Cumulative-to-delta conversion.
- **`processor/metricstransformprocessor/factory.go`** — Metrics transform processor.
- **`exporter/loadbalancingexporter/metrics_exporter.go`** — ConsumeMetrics() implementation.

### Jaeger Span Metrics (Key Use Case)

- **`connector/spanmetricsconnector/connector.go`** — Consumes traces, produces metrics. Stores `metricsConsumer consumer.Metrics` to call downstream.
- **`connector/spanmetricsconnector/factory.go`** — Factory creating traces-to-metrics connector. Receives `nextConsumer consumer.Metrics`.
- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/components.go`** — References `spanmetricsconnector.NewFactory()`.
